fixed_policy_verbatim: 중복 정의: 원본 question ID가 있으면 ID 기준, 없으면 정규화한 질문 문자열 기준(소문자화, 앞뒤 공백 제거, 연속 공백은 하나로). 기대 개수는 TriviaQA held-out 294개(오답까지 같은 것 236개), ARC-Easy 10개, CommonsenseQA 1개야. 다르게 나오면 직접 센 값을 쓰고 차이의 원인을 기록해.
A1 주 결과는 기존 값이야. 중복을 뺀 결과는 민감도 분석으로 보고해.
A3 주 결과는 (a) 실제로 쓴 정책(span 포함, alias 1개)이야. (b) exact-only + 전체 alias는 민감도 분석이야.
A2 충돌 판정은 SQuAD-style 정규화 함수 하나로 통일하고, 오답이 전체 alias 중 하나와 같으면 충돌로 봐.
bootstrap: 질문 단위(cluster), seed 42, AUROC는 1,000회, 개입은 10,000회.
추정기 비교: "LR의 AUROC ≥ MD이면서 split-half는 MD보다 낮다"가 유지되면 유지, 부등호 하나가 바뀌면 약화, 둘 다 바뀌면 역전.
개입: 부호, 그리고 random 초과가 0인지가 유지되는지.
D.3: CI 하한이 .5보다 큰지, random-direction p가 유지되는지.

implementation_frozen_before_computation.original_question_id: Use source question_id/QuestionId if supplied; sequential generated pair IDs triviaqa_00000 etc are row IDs, not original question IDs. Otherwise normalize question string.
implementation_frozen_before_computation.duplicate_removal: Remove held-out rows whose question cluster occurs in training; retain remaining within-heldout repeats and bootstrap by shared question cluster.
implementation_frozen_before_computation.squad_normalization: lowercase; remove ASCII punctuation; remove standalone articles a/an/the; collapse whitespace (standard SQuAD). Use this same function for A2 and policy (b). Policy (a) reproduces the original labeling function exactly, including its punctuation handling.
implementation_frozen_before_computation.reproduction_gate: Absolute point-estimate discrepancy >0.001 halts the affected item/cell before sensitivity; preserve failure and continue independent cells. Compare all available originally reported primary metrics; CIs computed under the requested cluster/seed policy are new CIs, not expected to match older row-bootstrap CIs.

split_half.grouped_assignment: List unique question keys in first-occurrence training order; default_rng(seed).permutation(groups); split at floor(number_of_groups/2); all rows in a group stay together.
split_half.estimators: Reuse original fitting code/settings within halves only; no full-training refit.

implementation_frozen_before_computation.geometry: Reuse stored training subspaces and null bases; if absent regenerate identical null construction/seeds only as explicitly authorized for T4. Preserve original BH family, substituting recomputed TriviaQA p values while retaining unaffected cells. Record inability to recover family or bases as blocked, never infer significance from energy alone.
implementation_frozen_before_computation.operating_point: Reuse original seed-20260916 calibration/evaluation partition and stored numeric thresholds; no recalibration; reuse original score scaling.
implementation_frozen_before_computation.intervention: Question-cluster bootstrap on union of evaluated questions; retain seed multiplicities and compute equal-weight mean of within-seed means. Random null unit remains direction; compare absolute effects, matching original protocol.
implementation_frozen_before_computation.own_generation: No inference. Re-label stored answers. Preserve original prompt/readout, frozen direction, random direction seed, and answer extraction. Missing hidden states for newly included answers make the full sensitivity blocked; do not silently restrict to old labels.
